text:
Maya: Hey team — can we schedule a short readout for the inference perf benchmarks? Want to review latency/cost dashboards + quantization impact. Wed or Thu this week?
Samir: Wed 10am PT works for me.
Leo: I'm OOO Wed morning, Thu 11am PT ok for me.
Taylor: I can do Wed but need it after infra daily (9:30+). Thu earliest 11:30.
Maya: OK looks like Wed 10am PT is contested. Quick poll: if you prefer Thu, react with :thumbsup:, if Wed, react with :eyes:.
Samir: Wed :eyes:.
Leo: Thu :thumbsup:.
Taylor: Wed but can shift to Thu if Leo is key.
Maya: To move this forward, propose agenda so people can prep. Draft agenda:
```
1) 10m - Readout: aggregate latency (p50/p95/p99) + token throughput
2) 10m - Cost breakdown: per-token and per-inference for top 3 flows
3) 10m - Quantization & kernel regressions (impact on accuracy & tail latency)
4) 10m - Ops actions: batching, cache configs, fallback policies
5) 5m - Next steps / owners
```
Maya: Can folks volunteer items to own? Need someone to pull the dashboard CSV and someone to prepare the slides with charts. Also please post any regressions to this thread by Tue EOD.
Samir: I'll pull the perf dashboard and upload CSV. @Leo can you handle quantization comparison slides?
Leo: Yep, I can do the quantization slides. Will include INT8 vs FP16 p99 and delta in tokens/sec.
Taylor: I'll write a 1-slide summary for infra: kernel selection changes, GPU occupancy, tail latency notes.
Samir: Uploading CSV now -> https://redwood-internal/files/perf/1772034567/summary.csv
Maya: Thanks. I'll create the calendar invite once we confirm time. If Leo needs Thu, we can move to Thu 11am. Does anyone need longer than 45m?
Taylor: 45m is fine.
Samir: fine.
Leo: Thu 11am would be safer for me. If we move, can we keep the same agenda.
Maya: Decision: move to Thu 11am PT to maximize attendance (Leo and infra both), calendar invite incoming. Pre-read: please add CSVs + a short note (1-2 bullets) about any anomalies.
infra-bot: meeting created: "Inference Perf Readout" Thu 11:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123 (organizer: Maya)
Maya: Please post your pre-read by Tue EOD. Also tag any owners in the slides: Samir (dashboards), Leo (quant), Taylor (infra). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Samir: Will post charts + small notebook gist before Tue EOD.
Leo: Will add quantization charts and short notes on accuracy checks.
Taylor: Adding GPU occupancy numbers and kernel rollout notes.
Maya: One more ask — include 99th percentile raw trace for a couple of heavy requests so we can inspect KV cache effects.
Samir: Got it, will attach 99th trace sample.
infra-bot: reminder scheduled: upload deadline Tue 23:59 PT.
Maya: Great — see you all Thu 11am.
Samir: Thanks!
Leo: Thanks.
Taylor: Thanks all.
